classification: actor record layout - offsets and semantics only, no game data
purpose: The native runtime's actor record mirrors the game's own actor layout so that decoded ROM tables index correctly and translated 68000 routines need no field shims.
actor_stride_source: every distinct A4/A6 in the milestone-1 object-emission watchpoint log lands on this grid; the grid is anchored at the player slot 0xFF8380
scope_note: Only fields the game's own collision, animation-selection and emission paths are proven to consume are listed. An exhaustive labelling of the whole record is deliberately not attempted; unlisted bytes are UNRESOLVED and must not be invented.

fields.name: state
fields.source: 0x01D042 tests it against 1 before a hit is allowed
fields.meaning: actor liveness/state; collision requires the value 1 on the defender

fields.name: type
fields.source: 0x0A9B80 actor-type jump table; street aliens are type 12
fields.meaning: actor family selector for the emission jump table

fields.name: facing
fields.source: 0x01D296 and 0x01D2A4 negate the box x centre when non-zero
fields.meaning: facing flag; mirrors actor-local x offsets when set

fields.name: world_x
fields.source: 0x01D2AE adds it to the attacker box x; 0x01D008 compares it for knockback direction

fields.name: world_y
fields.source: 0x01D2EA adds it to the attacker box y

fields.name: world_z
fields.source: 0x01D26A adds it to the attacker box depth
fields.meaning: actor depth along the belt-scroller lane axis

fields.name: anim_record
fields.source: 0x01CF84 and 0x01CF90 dereference it for the collision selectors; milestone 1 tracked it across the emission window
fields.meaning: pointer to the live animation record; bytes +8 and +9 are the hurt and attack box selectors

fields.name: hit_value
fields.source: 0x01CFCE writes the attack record's +0x0E here on the defender, and 0x01CFDA on the attacker when its own is still zero
fields.meaning: latched hit value; written on BOTH parties, which is why a naive defender-only reading of this byte mis-scores hit events

fields.name: hit_source
fields.meaning: identifier of the actor that landed the hit

fields.name: table_set
fields.source: 0x01CF9C and 0x01CFB0; word +0 offsets the hurt table, word +2 the attack table
fields.meaning: pointer to this actor family's collision table set

fields.name: attacker_id
fields.source: 0x01D05C compares it against the defender's per-attacker latch
fields.meaning: this actor's identity when acting as an attacker

fields.name: per_attacker_latch
fields.source: 0x01D058 indexes it by the attacker's +0xD1; 0x01D0C2 writes the attacker's +0x67 into it
fields.meaning: per-attacker already-hit latch preventing one attack from repeatedly hitting

fields.name: latch_index
fields.source: 0x01D054 loads it as the index into the defender's latch array
fields.meaning: this actor's slot index within a defender's per-attacker latch array

derived_fields.name: sel_hurt
derived_fields.source: byte +8 of the record at anim_record, read at 0x01CF94
derived_fields.meaning: hurt-box selector; 0 means the actor cannot be hit
derived_fields.note: not stored in the actor record; the runtime resolves it from the live animation record

derived_fields.name: sel_attack
derived_fields.source: byte +9 of the record at anim_record, read at 0x01CF88
derived_fields.meaning: attack-box selector; 0 means the actor cannot hit
derived_fields.note: not stored in the actor record; the runtime resolves it from the live animation record
